description:
Preview or write a spec-first Atomic Design scaffold for agent-created files.

Default is non-mutating: approved=false returns a dry-run JSON plan with the exact spec path, guardrails, and next generation commands.
To write the spec, pass approved=true. This writes only the registry spec; generated code still requires generate_code or memi generate, so quality gates stay intact.

approved.description: Must be true to write the spec. false returns a dry-run plan.

composesSpecs.description: Existing component specs this component composes. Invalid for atom scaffolds.

intent.description: Agent task or product intent behind the scaffold.

kind.description: Scaffold kind. component writes specs/components/<Name>.json; page writes specs/pages/<Name>.json.

level.description: Atomic Design level for component scaffolds. Inferred when omitted.

name.description: Spec name. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

purpose.description: Purpose copied into the generated spec.

shadcnBase.description: shadcn/ui base components for component scaffolds.

name: scaffold_agent_design_files
